original_numbered_excerpts.23: |start = Speak to any of the three TzHaar next to the collapsed tunnel.
original_numbered_excerpts.34: |items = * [[Rune pickaxe]] or [[Dragon pickaxe]] (The toolbelt does not work, and Gilded pickaxes also do not work.)
original_numbered_excerpts.35: * 20 blocks of stone (obtained during quest from TzHaar mine)
original_numbered_excerpts.38: * [[Chisel]] , [[Dwarven army axe]], or use the one on your Toolbelt.
original_numbered_excerpts.44: There is a bank in the city, so you will not need all the items in your inventory.
original_numbered_excerpts.53: To begin the quest speak to one of the three guards ([[TzHaar-Mej-Malk]], [[TzHaar-Xil-Tog]] or [[TzHaar-Hur-Frok]]) guarding a cave entrance located down the path east of the [[TzHaar city]] entrance (at the very top of the Karamja volcano). They will explain that some tunnels have been knocked down, trapping a few TzHaar. If the player already completed the [[Elder Kiln]], they will describe a TokTz-Ket-Dill that they found on their way to the kiln.
original_numbered_excerpts.56: * Talk to [[TzHaar-Ket-Grol]] south west (near the crack in wall) of where you are when the dialogue has ended. He will not allow you to go in unless you have the proper materials. He writes them down on a [[Stone tablet (TzHaar)|stone tablet]], but it is in the [[TzHaar language]]!
original_numbered_excerpts.57: * Go to the TzHaar Library to get a translation book for the list of required items. The Library is located on the north west side of the city between the bank and the rune store, you need to enter through the "Cave entrance".
original_numbered_excerpts.59: [[File:TokTz_Ashes.png|thumb|The 'books' in the back of the library.]]
original_numbered_excerpts.60: * Talk to the Librarian, [[TzHaar-Mej-Lor]], who sadly (and amusingly) shows you that all the books have been burnt to ashes by the heat! It then tells you to go to [[Varrock]] for the original book.
original_numbered_excerpts.61: * Now head to the Varrock Castle. The library is in the back of the castle, the northernmost room on the ground floor. You can teleport or use the nearby [[Fairy ring]] (coordinates DKR lies outside the nearby [[Grand Exchange]]).
original_numbered_excerpts.62: * Talk to [[Reldo]] and he will tell you to search the bookcases for the [[TzHaar Tourist Guide]].
original_numbered_excerpts.63: * Search the second bookcase from the south on the western wall, and you will find the book. The bookcase that it is in is slightly discolored.
original_numbered_excerpts.64: * Get to TzHaar again. The [[fairy ring]] for TzHaar is BLP; alternatively, you can use your [[Amulet of Glory]] to go to Karamja and walk to the volcano, or teleport with a [[TokKul-Zo]].
original_numbered_excerpts.65: * Go to [[TzHaar-Ket-Grol]]. He will now ask what have you been able to translate and ask you some questions and the answers are: a pickaxe (you'll need a [[Rune pickaxe]]), oak planks (you'll need 13-15 [[oak planks]]) and blocks of stone (18-20 blocks of stone from TzHaar mine).
original_numbered_excerpts.66: * Go east and tell [[TzHaar-Ket-Rok]] that you are allowed in the mine.
original_numbered_excerpts.70: * Now enter the mine and speak with [[TzHaar-Hur-Brekt]] and keep talking until you get to change the plot of the play so that "the humans started it." At this point you have to help "write" a play.

original_numbered_excerpts.21: '''Tzhaar tourist guide''' is a [[book]] required in the [[TokTz-Ket-Dill]] quest. It has a note stuck to the front inside cover as well as text. It can be found in the [[bookcase]] of a [[Player-owned house]] after the quest is completed, with the note still inside it.
original_numbered_excerpts.23: For the note found within the book explaining the Tzhaar number see [[TzHaar_language#TzHaar numbering system|Tzhaar numbering]].

original_numbered_excerpts.247:
Difficulty:
Experienced
Length:
Medium
Quest Requirements:
None
Skill/Other Requirements:
40 Attack
original_numbered_excerpts.253:
Must be able to defeat a level 100 monster
Items Needed to Complete Quest:
Rune pickaxe, 14 Oak planks, Hammer, Chisel, a Range attack method, a Mage attack method, Food, and Armor.
Items Recommended for Quest:
Runes to teleport to Varrock, an Amulet of glory(4) to teleport to Karamja, and a weapon with crush attack (more powerful than a Rune pickaxe).
Items Acquired During Quest:
A Stone tablet, Tzhaar tourist guide, 14 Treated oak plank, 17 Stone slabs, 17 Pillars, Big bones, and 1K Tokkul.
original_numbered_excerpts.254:
Quest Points:
1
Reward:
5k Attack XP, 5k Strength XP, 10k Crafting XP, 15k Mining XP, 20k Construction XP, access to a new TzHaar mining area, and 2 free spins on the Squeal of Fortune.
Start Point:
TzHaar City, east of the city's Entrance/Exit.
To Start:
Speak to TzHaar-Hur-Frok, TzHaar-Xil-Tog, or TzHaar-Mej-Malk.
Instructions:
original_numbered_excerpts.257: Speak to one of the TzHaar standing outside the collapsed tunnel in the northeastern area of the TzHaar City. They will tell you that a creature, called TokTz-Ket-Dill, has caused great damage to the city by digging tunnels underneath it. Offer to help repair the tunnels and kill the TokTz-Ket-Dill.
original_numbered_excerpts.264: Go south of the quest start point and speak to TzHaar-Ket-Grol. He will give you a Stone tablet. The tablet, however, is written in the TzHaar language and he will refuse to translate it for you. Keep talking to him, until he directs you to go to the TzHaar Library to find help with the translation.
original_numbered_excerpts.271: Head north-west of the furnace in TzHaar City and enter the cave to find the TzHaar Library. Once there, talk to TzHaar-Mej-Lor, the Lord of TzHaar Library, for help. From your discussion, you will realize that the piles of ashes in the bookcases used to be the JalYt (human) books. You will also learn that the books came from the Varrock Library.
original_numbered_excerpts.278: Go to the Varrock Library, located on the ground floor of the Varrock Castle on the north side, and talk to Reldo. He will tell you that the TzHaar tourist guide is in one of the bookcases. Search the bookcase in the southwest corner, that is the middle of a set of three to obtain the guide, then read it.
original_numbered_excerpts.285: Return to TzHaar City and talk to TzHaar-Ket-Grol. He will quiz you about the translation of the tablet. Give him the answers: "A pickaxe," "Oak planks," and "Blocks of stone." He will then tell you to get your Oak planks treated and to also learn about mining through magma.
original_numbered_excerpts.333: Tell TzHaar-Hur-Brekt that all roles have distributed and he will teach you how to safely mine through magma. Now mine the nearby Obsidian walls until you have about 20 Stone slabs. You can mine 2 Stone slabs from each Obsidian wall before it needs to respawn. Use your Chisel and Hammer on the Stone slabs to make them into Pillars.

original_numbered_excerpts.249:
Start location: Speak to any of the three guards at the collapsed tunnel entrance in the south-eastern section of TzHaar.

Required:

Skills: Level 40 Attack, Level 41 Mining, Level 43 Crafting, Level 45 Strength, Level 50 Construction
original_numbered_excerpts.251: Items: Rune pickaxe or Dragon pickaxe, 15 oak planks, chisel, hammer,
original_numbered_excerpts.252:
Range Weapon and ammo (knives or darts cannot be used), Runes to cast 20+ Water Spells.

Suggested:

Skills: Able to defeat level 47 monsters using only Ranged and Magic, able to defeat a level 100 monster
original_numbered_excerpts.267: Suggested: Runes for Varrock Teleport, Glory Amulet
original_numbered_excerpts.269: 1. Speak to the guards at the quest start in the eastern portion of TzHaar, outside the collapsed tunnel. They explain that a large creature, TokTz-Ket-Dill, has been burrowing under the TzHaar city, endangering everyone there. They cannot get through without risking another collapse, so they need someone small - you - to go through the only entrance they have. Volunteer to help stabilize the tunnels and they will send you to TzHaar-Ket-Grol to enter the tunnels.
original_numbered_excerpts.273: 2. Head south and a little west from the guards and speak to TzHaar-Ket-Grol about going into the tunnels. He does not trust a JalYt (Human) like yourself to be able to help, and will not allow you to enter until you have materials - Tok-Xil-Im, Tok-Ket-Hurt, and TokJal-Hurt.
original_numbered_excerpts.275: 3. Unless you happen to be an expert on the TzHaar language, you will need to go to the TzHaar Library to figure out what TzHaar-Ket-Grol wants. Head north-west until you reach the plaza. The library is further west from there. Enter and speak to TzHaar-Mej-Lor about the TzHaar language. He will refer you to the JalYt section, which is filled with ashes from books that had burnt. When you fail to get any help from him, he will tell you that Reldo in the Varrock Library sent him the books.
original_numbered_excerpts.277: 4. Make your way to Varrock (teleporting is the easiest way). Go to the library in the Varrock Palace and speak to Reldo about the TzHaar language. He has a copy of the book you need, the TzHaar Tourist Guide, somewhere in the bookcases. It happens to be in the second bookcase up from the south-west corner of the room.
original_numbered_excerpts.283: 5. When you open the book, you will find a note - read it to discover the meanings of the numbers. Read through the book itself to find translations for TzHaar words. Translating the stone tablet TzHaar-Ket-Grol gave you gives:
original_numbered_excerpts.302: 6. Return to TzHaar-Ket-Grol and tell him that you need a pickaxe, oak planks (which TzHaar-Hur-Frok can treat), and blocks of stone. TzHaar-Ket-Grol will instruct you to head to the mines to the north-east, where you need to learn how to mine magma.
